item_argument_dependencies.argument: Adopt the specified statewise linear isotropic Newtonian stress and Fourier flux with explicit coefficient range, tensor convention, units and scope.
Adopt the pointwise C2 simple-fluid fundamental relation and explicitly state the local temperature, thermodynamic pressure, state coordinates and nonclaims.
Define smooth positive-density mass and unforced momentum equations with an explicit C1 pressure law and no built-in response-sign condition.
Define the constant-density divergence-free Newtonian branch, pressure multiplier, stress reduction and kinematic viscosity.
Use the exact conditional Gibbs residual identity, substitute Newtonian/Fourier closures, and apply the independent pointwise quadratic coefficient equivalence.
Identify the barotropic pressure with a fixed-entropy state restriction, differentiate the smooth Euler equations at rest, and verify positive-response plane waves.
Adopt an explicit dimensionless-log perfect-gas state relation, derive the complete temperature balance from local energy, then specialize to isentropic adiabatic trajectories.
Localize the adopted momentum balance, derive the kinetic identity and integrate it with explicit periodic or no-slip boundary-flux cancellation.
Choose pure volumetric strain and a negative bulk coefficient to obtain a strictly negative pointwise entropy residual while shear viscosity is positive.
Construct an explicit local state with positive temperature and heat response but negative fixed-entropy pressure response, then verify an exponentially growing first-variation mode.

Its notation for the trace coefficient is translated to zeta=lambda+2mu/3, and the local proof imposes the exact sym(K) quadratic condition. No empirical coefficient values are imported.
